comment:
* Uses a HashMap to track carrier and RAT usage, in terms of duration and number of calls. * *

This tracker is first used by each call, and then used for aggregating usages across calls. * *

This class is not thread-safe. Callers (from {@link PersistAtomsStorage} and {@link * VoiceCallSessionStats}) should ensure each instance of this class is accessed by only one thread * at a time.

variables.name: mRatUsageMap
variables.comment: A Map holding all carrier-RAT combinations and corresponding durations and call counts.

variables.name: mLastKey
variables.comment: Tracks last carrier/RAT combination during a call.

variables.name: mLastKeyTimestampMillis
variables.comment: Tracks the time when last carrier/RAT combination was updated.

methods.comment: Creates an RAT tracker from saved atoms at startup.

methods.comment: Append the map to javanano persist atoms.

methods.comment: Adds one RAT usage to the tracker during a call session.

methods.name: public void conclude(long timestampMillis)
methods.comment: Finalize the duration of the last RAT at the end of a call session.

methods.name: public VoiceCallRatTracker mergeWith(VoiceCallRatTracker that)
methods.comment: Merges this tracker with another instance created during a call session.
